title: MSC Administration for the Management of Type 1 Diabetic Patients
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate whether the administration of multipotent stromal cell also referred as to mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs), modified Type 1 Diabetes progression.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* differential diagnosis of Type 1 Diabetes
* diagnosed performed at most 1 year before enrollment
* pancreatic reserve of insulin higher than 0.8 nmol/L/h
* good general health status
* informed consent of patient
* consent of treating physician
* proved psychiatric competence to be enrolled in a clinical study

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy
* significant comorbidities
* HIV, HBV, HCV, HTLV-1, HLTV-2 or VDRL positive
